content:
maria: Quick sync — Orbit Interop Summit (co-hosted track) next Tue. Need final speaker roster, demo run order, livestream cue points, and swag pickup plan. Can we lock these today?
aj: I can take speaker confirmations. Who's the final list from Orbit? (Olivia is lead contact)
maria: Olivia emailed a shortlist: Olivia (Orbit), Priya (Edge SI), Ben (CloudMarketplace). We need talk titles and 1-line bios by EOD. Can marketing handle short intros? @sara
sara: Yep — I can draft 2-line bios and pull headshots. Send any corrections by 4pm or we'll use LinkedIn blurbs.
todd: For demos — we have 2 live demos: 1) Redwood-hosted model routing (mini load test) 2) Orbit edge inference on compact hardware. Need fallback recorded vids in case of network/AV fail. Who's producing the videos?
june: Expo ops can record quick 3-5m fallback clips if teams approve. Shipping note: demo hardware arrives booth-side Wed morning. Carrier tracking: UPS 1Z999... (will post link).
maria: Run-of-show draft below — please review and flag gaps.
```
17:00 - stage intro (maria)
17:05 - panel kickoff (10m) — quick intros, then seg to demo A
17:15 - demo A (redwood routing) — live, 6m + q&a 4m
17:25 - demo B (orbit edge) — live hardware, 6m + q&a 4m
17:35 - joint feature talk (ben) — 7m
17:42 - lightning ops tips (priya) — 5m
17:47 - closing & CTA (maria + olivia) — 3m
17:50 - livestream close / move to booth demos
```
aj: Two notes: 1) add a 2m AV buffer between demos for swap and mic handoff. 2) Is there a PTZ camera operator?
june: AV vendor confirmed single camera + switcher. They recommended a 90s buffer for hardware swaps. We should plan for pre-cued camera shots.
todd: Hardware demo checklist (short):
- power strip + cable ramps
- HDMI capture + spare cable
- local fallback video USB drive
- ethernet fallback (we have 1.2GB/s wired)
- laptop with preloaded docker image and model weights
I'll bring spare NVMe and USB-to-Ethernet dongles.
sara: Swag update — we have sticker bundles (300), shirts (100, mixed S-XL), and 50 demo postcards with QR codes. Packing list: 10 demo bundles per partner rep for give-away. Who's picking up from office?
maria: Olivia wants a special Orbit co-branded sticker sheet (50) and a small stack of Orbit postcards. Can partnerships pick these up from marketing by Thu? @aj @sara
aj: I can do Thu afternoon pickup. Which office? SF warehouse?
sara: Yep, SF warehouse. I'll add a pickup note with SKU and cart link.
expo-bot: Reminder: All exhibitor items must be declared in the venue manifest by Fri 18:00. Failure to declare may incur fees.
june: Shipping timeline: Drop-off to carrier by Thu EOD to reach Wed morning delivery. I'll DM carrier contact to request hold for expo dock.
todd: Demo fallback plan: if live hardware fails, cut to pre-recorded walk-through and run a canned load test on Redwood Dedicated in the cloud. We need 1 engineer at booth and 1 on-call to trigger fallback.
maria: Who volunteers booth engineer? Todd can do mornings, Priya can do afternoons per Orbit. @todd @maria
todd: I can cover the first shift. Priya confirmed for 2-5pm.
sara: Marketing will staff swag table from 10-2. Need headcount for demo handouts after the talk.
aj: Livestream cues — we need 3 timestamps: intro cut, demo switch, close CTA. Who has the RTMP key?
june: AV vendor will provide RTMP. I'll circulate creds to the production channel once secured.
maria: Can someone compile final assets (bios, one-slide demo outlines, fallback video links, swag manifest, AV creds) into a single folder? Use this naming: ois-summit-2026-assets.zip
sara: I'll create the folder and ping here when ready. ETA 3:30pm.
todd: I'll upload fallback videos and hardware photos to the folder.
aj: Final ask — rehearsal slot tomorrow 2pm PT (30m). Can all speakers + AV ops make it? Olivia said yes.
maria: Locking rehearsal 2pm. Please join the calendar invite. If any timing issues DM me.
sara: Also: press outreach — a short embargoed announcement with Orbit for the panel. Legal wants sight of the copy by Fri. I'll circulate draft.
maria: Thanks everyone. Post any blocker now. If no blockers, I'll mark this thread as final runbook after Sara posts the asset folder link. :rocket:
